g.title: crate Document-style component catalog for kivact-ui-basic.
crate::docs Page and example definitions of the catalog, one file per component.
crate::docs::accordion Catalog page of Accordion: single, multiple and controlled open sections.
crate::docs::alert Catalog page of Alert: default, destructive and with an action.
crate::docs::alert_dialog Catalog page of Alert Dialog: confirmation, destructive, media and small sizes.
crate::docs::aspect_ratio Catalog page of Aspect Ratio: a photo at 16:9, square and portrait boxes.
crate::docs::attachment Catalog page of Attachment: default, sizes, states and vertical.
crate::docs::avatar Catalog page of Avatar: picture, fallback, sizes, badge and group.
crate::docs::badge Catalog page of Badge: variants, with icon and as a pressable badge.
crate::docs::breadcrumb Catalog page of Breadcrumb: basic trail, ellipsis and right-to-left.
crate::docs::bubble Catalog page of Bubble: variants, alignment, reactions and pressable.
crate::docs::button Catalog page of Button: variants, sizes, icons, loading and disabled.
crate::docs::button_group Catalog page of Button Group: horizontal, vertical, separator and text.
crate::docs::calendar Catalog page of Calendar: single, range, disabled dates and dropdown caption.
crate::docs::card Catalog page of Card: login form, small, bordered header and image.
crate::docs::carousel Catalog page of Carousel: default, several per view, vertical and loop.
crate::docs::chart Catalog page of Chart: bar, stacked, line, area, pie, radar and radial.
crate::docs::checkbox Catalog page of Checkbox: basic, description, disabled and select all.
crate::docs::code_block Catalog page of Code Block: title, line numbers, small size, scrolling.
crate::docs::collapsible Catalog page of Collapsible: a trigger that shows and hides a region.
crate::docs::combobox Catalog page of Combobox: basic, clear, multiple and disabled.
crate::docs::command Catalog page of Command: the standard command palette in a dialog.
crate::docs::context_menu Catalog page of Context Menu: basic, submenu, checkboxes and a custom target.
crate::docs::data_table Catalog page of Data Table: `kivact::ui::data_table` in the Lyra theme.
crate::docs::date_picker Catalog page of Date Picker: single, format, range and options.
crate::docs::dialog Catalog page of Dialog: default, form, no close button and confirmation.
crate::docs::direction Catalog page of Direction: provide a reading direction and read it back.
crate::docs::drawer Catalog page of Drawer: a modal panel that is swiped away with its handle.
crate::docs::dropdown_menu Catalog page of Dropdown Menu: items, checkboxes, radio group and submenu.
crate::docs::empty Catalog page of EmptyState: icon media, outline and with actions.
crate::docs::field Catalog page of Field: label, description, error, orientation and sets.
crate::docs::hover_card Catalog page of Hover Card: a preview that opens on hover.
crate::docs::input Catalog page of Input: basic, label, disabled, invalid and with a button.
crate::docs::input_group Catalog page of Input Group: icons, text, buttons and block addons.
crate::docs::input_otp Catalog page of Input OTP: groups, patterns and completion.
crate::docs::item Catalog page of Item: variants, media, group and pressable.
crate::docs::kbd Catalog page of Kbd: key caps, groups and use inside a button.
crate::docs::label Catalog page of Label: a label for an input and a small form.
crate::docs::marker Catalog page of Marker: default, separator, border and icon.
crate::docs::menubar Catalog page of Menubar: basic menus, checks and radios, and a submenu.
crate::docs::message Catalog page of Message: received, sent and a conversation.
crate::docs::message_scroller Catalog page of Message Scroller: a long log and a conversation that grows.
crate::docs::native_select Catalog page of Native Select: basic, sizes, disabled and invalid.
crate::docs::navigation_menu Catalog page of Navigation Menu: panels with links, and plain links.
crate::docs::pagination Catalog page of Pagination: pages helper, manual links, labels and long lists.
crate::docs::popover Catalog page of Popover: the dialog at a trigger, its placement and alignment.
crate::docs::progress Catalog page of Progress: static, label with value and interactive.
crate::docs::questionnaire Catalog page of Questionnaire: choices, input, optional steps and submit.
crate::docs::radio_group Catalog page of Radio Group: basic, descriptions, horizontal and in a field.
crate::docs::resizable Catalog page of Resizable: horizontal, vertical and a grip handle.
crate::docs::scroll_area Catalog page of Scroll Area: vertical, horizontal and both axes.
crate::docs::select Catalog page of Select: basic, sizes, disabled item and with icon.
crate::docs::separator Catalog page of Separator: horizontal and vertical lines.
crate::docs::sheet Catalog page of Sheet: the standard dialog attached to a side of the window.
crate::docs::sidebar Catalog page of Sidebar: groups, icon mode, sub-menus and frames.
crate::docs::skeleton Catalog page of Skeleton: an avatar row and a card placeholder.
crate::docs::slider Catalog page of Slider: single, range, step and vertical.
crate::docs::spinner Catalog page of Spinner: default, in a button and with text.
crate::docs::switch Catalog page of Switch: basic, description, disabled and settings.
crate::docs::table Catalog page of Table: basic, footer and selectable rows.
crate::docs::tabs Catalog page of Tabs: default, disabled tab, vertical and the line variant.
crate::docs::textarea Catalog page of Textarea: basic, label, disabled and with a button.
crate::docs::toast Catalog page of Toast: pushed notifications, variants, actions and durations.
crate::docs::toggle Catalog page of Toggle: default, outline, sizes, icons and disabled.
crate::docs::toggle_group Catalog page of Toggle Group: multiple, single, outline and vertical.
crate::docs::tooltip Catalog page of Tooltip: default, sides, icon buttons and keyboard shortcut.
crate::docs::trace Catalog page of Trace: lines, collapsible detail and several steps.
crate::docs::typography Catalog page of Typography: headings, prose, lists, inline code and small text.
crate::fonts The catalog's offline OFL font bytes, for the app and its tests.
crate::look The kit tokens of the theme in effect, for the catalog's own styles.
crate::model Page and example types shared by the catalog shell and its page files.
crate::page Render one documentation page: header, usage and example panels with code.
crate::pages Every catalog page and its examples, as the catalog tests read them.
crate::shell The catalog shell: top bar, searchable component list and page area.
